description: Ecoshape and public flood-defence partners provide aerial photographs of the entire Hondsbossche Dunes project area. The native description states that these were collected simultaneously with airborne LiDAR measurements. The custom field lists nine acquisition dates from May 2015 through March 2018. Coverage: 2015-05-24, 2015-12-28, 2016-05-04, 2016-09-01, 2016-12-05, 2017-04-19, 2017-08-11, 2017-12-06, 2018-03-19. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Photographs are distinct from the separately deposited elevation measurements. Camera resolution, georeferencing and accuracy are unstated. No image bodies were acquired. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hondsbossche collection identifies these dune systems as primary flood defence created with sand nourishment. Simulation use concerns their monitored geometry and morphological development.
